about:
Automotive Equipment, Inc. (AEI) was founded in 1998 in Wichita, Kansas, by Steve Friesen, who serves as co-owner and founder. The company is co-owned by Friesen and Laura Warner, who also acts as general manager.

AEI operates as a distributor and service provider for automotive lifts of all varieties. The eight-person team — including a service manager, lead technician, and purchasing specialist — brings over 70 years of combined experience to lift sales, installation, and ongoing maintenance. The company emphasizes honest work and building real relationships with customers.

The company serves automotive repair shops, dealerships, and fleet operators that require lifts for vehicle service. Its product focus spans the full range of automotive lifts, from two-post and four-post models to specialty lifts, though specific brand names are not disclosed in the available information.

AEI positions itself on the strength of national distribution networks backed by local representation. The founders highlight their team’s collective experience and a service philosophy centered on doing things right the first time, treating customers as they would want to be treated.

name: Automotive Friction Material
old_description: Proudly serving Birmingham, AL and surrounding markets with clutches and brakes for a huge variety of applications for over 40 years.
about:
Automotive Friction Material operates from Birmingham, Alabama, where it has served the surrounding region with clutch and brake components for more than 40 years. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The business stocks new and remanufactured clutches for automotive, trucking, tractor, and on- and off-highway applications. Its brake shoe inventory ranges from golf cart units to the largest industrial equipment, with a specialization in medium- to heavy-duty brake shoes. The company also supplies electric brakes, industrial brakes, and tractor brakes, and offers a rebuilding service for parts not carried in stock.

Customers span agricultural, automotive, trucking, industrial, mining, and machining sectors. The company positions itself as a direct source for fleets, equipment operators, and repair shops seeking to reduce lead times and costs by bypassing intermediaries.

Automotive Friction Material emphasizes fast service and the ability to source or rebuild hard-to-find components, promoting a direct-to-customer model that aims to save time and money.

name: Automotive Industrial Paint Supply Auburn
about:
Automotive Industrial Paint Supply operates from Auburn, Washington, where it has served the automotive refinish industry since 2005. The family-owned business was established to supply paint, clearcoats, primers, and related body shop products to professional technicians across the region.

The company runs a warehouse and storefront in Auburn, providing distribution of automotive refinish coatings and custom paint mixing into spray cans. Its vendor partnerships allow it to stock a range of quality paint systems, clearcoats, and primers, with delivery coverage extending from Everett to Tacoma.

Its primary customers are automotive refinish professionals, including body shops and collision repair centers throughout the Puget Sound area. The company focuses on supplying the coatings and ancillary products these shops use daily.

The business emphasizes a combination of quality, price, and service, backed by technical expertise in paint systems. It highlights vendor relationships that enable cost savings for customers and a commitment to prompt regional delivery.

name: Automotive Manufacturing LLC.
old_description: Currently featured is Jim’s 1978 Chevy Cheyenne pick-up. This project was completed with parts custom made by  Automotive Manufacturing.
about:
Automotive Manufacturing LLC operates from Sunfield, Michigan, where it was founded in 1988 with the goal of supplying high-quality restoration parts to car enthusiasts. The company remains privately held, though the ownership structure is not publicly detailed, and the founders are not named in available materials.

The company manufactures replacement body panels and patch panels for classic American vehicles, covering brands such as Chevrolet, Ford, Dodge, Buick, Pontiac, and Oldsmobile. Parts are stamped from automotive-grade electro-coated rust-resistant American steel, using certified domestic steel to ensure durability. The firm maintains a complete inventory and leverages years of industry experience to serve restoration projects directly through its website and an eBay storefront.

Customers include individual enthusiasts and restoration shops working on vintage cars and trucks. A featured project involved custom-made parts for a 1978 Chevrolet Cheyenne pickup, illustrating the company's ability to produce both cataloged and bespoke components. The business invites inquiries for parts not listed online and encourages customers to submit their own projects for potential feature.

Automotive Manufacturing emphasizes direct-from-manufacturer pricing, affordable rust-repair solutions, and a commitment to adapting to customer needs. Its stated differentiators include the use of certified American steel, electro-coated finishes for corrosion resistance, and a mission to continuously expand options for restoration projects.

Its customer base includes automotive repair shops, heavy-duty fleet operators, and agricultural equipment dealers across the United States. The company leverages a nationwide warehouse network to serve the automotive aftermarket, heavy-duty, off-road, and agricultural sectors.

name: Automotive Specialty Equipment
old_description: AUTOMOTIVE SPECIALTY EQUIPMENT, INC. has dedicated itself to help increase the automotive service shops INCOME by providing name brand , vehicle repair & service equipment.
about:
Automotive Specialty Equipment, Inc. was founded in 1988 by Dan and Janet Duvall in Midvale, Utah. The couple started the business from their home, and a dedicated warehouse facility was added in 1996 to support growing customer demand. The company serves the Intermountain region, including Utah, Idaho, Nevada, and Wyoming.

The firm operates as a distributor of name-brand automotive repair and service equipment. Its product range includes vehicle lifts (two-post, four-post, inground, and home storage models), tire changers, wheel balancers, A/C recovery and recycling machines, air compressors, and a variety of hand and power tools. The company also provides ALI-certified hoist inspections, financing options, installation services, warranty support, and shipping.

Customers are primarily independent automotive service shops, dealership service departments, and home-garage enthusiasts across the Intermountain West. The company represents brands such as Robinair, Challenger, Mondolfo Ferro, ADG, and Haweka.

The business was built on the goal of helping service shops increase revenue by supplying reliable, brand-name equipment backed by technical expertise. The team’s combined automotive industry experience spans more than 48 years.

name: Automotive Test Solutions
old_description: The eSCOPE ELITE8 is the industries best automotive diagnostic scope and signal tester. A 8-channel scope with built-in tests, signal generators and outputs. Available in three configurations.
about:
Automotive Test Solutions was established in 2001 in Albuquerque, New Mexico, by Bernie C. Thompson and Neal R. Pederson. Thompson brings over 40 years of automotive repair experience and holds 27 U.S. and international patents, while Pederson’s background includes control systems for national laboratories and high-tech industries. The company began as a developer of patented diagnostic tools for the automotive sector.

The company manufactures a range of diagnostic equipment including multi-channel oscilloscopes (eSCOPE series), OBD II drivability scan tools (eSCAN), misfire detectors, pressure transducers, vibration analyzers, leak detectors, gas analyzers, borescopes, engine simulators, ignition analyzers, and training products. Electronic and software design is supported through its affiliate VI Control Systems, which has developed controls for lasers, particle accelerators, and nuclear reactors. A mobile diagnostic service, ATS Mobile Diagnostics, also operates under the same ownership.

Products are sold to automotive repair technicians, independent shops, and original equipment manufacturers; the eSCOPE ELITE8 carries a GM-approved tool designation. The company’s tools have been recognized with awards from Motor Magazine, TST, Undercar Digest, Transmission Digest, and the Mobile Air Conditioning Society spanning 2004 through 2021.

The founders’ combined expertise in automotive repair and advanced control systems drives the company’s focus on patented, award-winning solutions that translate complex vehicle data into actionable diagnostics for technicians of any skill level.

name: Autotiv Manufacturing
old_description: Guaranteed Quality   •   1 Day Expedites   •   Production Runs Starting from $.01/part
about:
Autotiv Manufacturing operates from Salem, New Hampshire, providing digital manufacturing services that include 3D printing, CNC machining, injection molding, urethane casting, and sheet metal fabrication. The company emphasizes speed and flexibility, with over 200 machines available for production.

The shop runs a range of processes: 3D printing in plastics, metals, and elastomers with 1-day expedited options; CNC machining holding tolerances of ±0.001 inch; injection molding for plastics, elastomers, and liquid silicone rubber with insert and overmolding capabilities; urethane casting for rigid or flexible polyurethanes; and sheet metal fabrication covering 4- to 26-gauge thicknesses. It supports volumes from single prototypes to millions of parts.

Autotiv serves customers across various industries, though specific sectors are not listed on its site. The company highlights a blend of domestic production and a vetted global supply chain, offering instant interactive quotes for hundreds of materials and finishes backed by manufacturing engineers.

Autotiv differentiates itself with a Quality Guarantee, 1-day expedited 3D printing (with a 4:30 PM EST cutoff), free DFM simulation for molding, and a focus on cost-effective, resilient production. Its core values stress excellence, innovation, integrity, customer focus, and teamwork.

name: Aved Electronics
old_description: When lives depend on technology, there’s no room for failure.
about:
Aved Electronics operates from Lowell, Massachusetts, as a brand under Lithion Battery Inc. The company focuses on custom power solutions for applications where reliability is critical.

Aved designs and manufactures custom battery packs, cable and harness assemblies, and electro-mechanical box builds. Its services span battery pack design and manufacturing, cable assembly, electro-mechanical integration, testing, and compliance support. The company states it is one of the largest custom battery pack manufacturers in the United States, with all production taking place at its Massachusetts facility.

The company serves customers ranging from start-ups to Fortune 500 firms across medical, military and defense, robotics, security, telecommunications, semiconductor, oceanographic research, homeland security, and industrial sectors. Its products are used in medical diagnosis, therapy, treatment, and surgery equipment, as well as in robotics and military operations.

Aved emphasizes a chemistry-agnostic approach, working with lithium-ion, primary lithium, nickel-metal hydride, and lead-acid cells. It maintains a quality management system certified to ISO 9001 and ISO 13485, and performs 100 percent testing on every battery produced. The company positions itself as a full-service custom battery solution designer, manufacturer, assembler, and tester, taking projects from prototype through production.
